say:1:1623438001:1.text: Weren't you going to ask me something earlier?
say:1:1623438001:1.source_cn: 你刚才是不是想聊聊来着？
say:1:1623438001:1.male: Weren't you going to ask me something earlier?
say:1:1623438001:1.female: Weren't you going to ask me something earlier?

say:3:1623438002:1.text: I'm getting by. One day at a time. But...
say:3:1623438002:1.source_cn: 现状……就这样吧，混过一天是一天。不过……
say:3:1623438002:1.male: I'm getting by. One day at a time. But...
say:3:1623438002:1.female: I'm getting by. One day at a time. But...

say:4:1623438004:1.text: Lately there's this... "support group". Yeah, that's what they call it. Students started it. Led by someone named... what was it again?
say:4:1623438004:1.source_cn: 最近，有个“互助团队”……对，是这个名字。这是一个学生...
say:4:1623438004:1.male: Lately there's this... "support group". Yeah, that's what they call it. Students started it. Led by someone named... what was it again?
say:4:1623438004:1.female: Lately there's this... "support group". Yeah, that's what they call it. Students started it. Led by someone named... what was it again?

say:5:1623438005:1.text: Olaya... Right, Olaya. She's the one who put it together.
say:5:1623438005:1.source_cn: 是……是奥莱雅。对，一个叫奥莱雅的学生带的头。
say:5:1623438005:1.male: Olaya... Right, Olaya. She's the one who put it together.
say:5:1623438005:1.female: Olaya... Right, Olaya. She's the one who put it together.

say:6:1623438006:1.text: Her voice keeps dropping, as if she's running out of strength. But when she says Olaya's name, a tiny spark lights up in her eyes.
say:6:1623438006:1.source_cn: 她说话的声音越来越小，仿佛用尽了力气，但提到奥莱雅时，...

say:7:1623438007:1.text: Olaya looks kinda scary. And she can be a bit... uh... blunt with her words.
say:7:1623438007:1.source_cn: 奥莱雅她看起来有点凶，说话也有些……呃，直白。
say:7:1623438007:1.male: Olaya looks kinda scary. And she can be a bit... uh... blunt with her words.
say:7:1623438007:1.female: Olaya looks kinda scary. And she can be a bit... uh... blunt with her words.

say:8:1623438008:1.text: But she has a good heart. Just... don't let the first impression scare you off.
say:8:1623438008:1.source_cn: 但是，她其实是个好人……真的。只要你别被她一开始的样子...
say:8:1623438008:1.male: But she has a good heart. Just... don't let the first impression scare you off.
say:8:1623438008:1.female: But she has a good heart. Just... don't let the first impression scare you off.

say:9:1623438009:1.text: If you're feeling helpless, maybe go check them out.
say:9:1623438009:1.source_cn: 如果你感觉很无助的话，也许可以去那里试试。
say:9:1623438009:1.male: If you're feeling helpless, maybe go check them out.
say:9:1623438009:1.female: If you're feeling helpless, maybe go check them out.

say:11:1623438003:1.text: Calm down? I don't know. Feels like there isn't much left in me to calm.
say:11:1623438003:1.source_cn: 调节情绪？唔……好像也没什么可调节的。
say:11:1623438003:1.male: Calm down? I don't know. Feels like there isn't much left in me to calm.
say:11:1623438003:1.female: Calm down? I don't know. Feels like there isn't much left in me to calm.

choice:2:1:2.text: Do you have any way to calm yourself down?
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 你有调节情绪的办法吗？
